_comment: Brands to track. 'queries' go to Google News search. A headline counts only if it matches the brand's 'match' regex and matches neither the brand's 'exclude' regex nor the global 'exclude' regex. Rules are re-applied to stored articles on every run, so tightening them also cleans old data.
exclude: Aktie News|So viel (Gewinn|hätten)|Kurs, Aktie, Chart|stock price|Stock Price, News, Quote|seasonal returns|rendements saisonniers|share capital|voting rights|droits de vote|transactions in own shares|actions propres|Financial Calendar|Calendrier financier|Estimates [–-] |EURONEXT:

youtube._comment: YouTube search settings. Each search costs 100 of the 10,000 free daily API units. A video counts for a brand if its title or description matches the brand's regex below and neither the brand's exclude regex nor the global exclude above.
